_comment: Hand-written reference subtitles: the atomic action underway at that prompt, in service of the session's larger goal. Written from what the bridge can see at generation time — the prompt plus the turns before it — never from the reply that had not happened yet. Where a prompt is thin ('ok restarted', 'sure check please') the atomic action is the thing the prompt is answering, which is legitimately in the preceding context; those are the cases the shipped prompt cannot reach, and they are deliberately kept in the set rather than filtered out.
